tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search current cultural events by Sofia/all-city scope, city, date, local time, venue, title, performer, or editorial collection. Returns stable event IDs and cursor pagination.

query.description: Performance-title search text. Bulgarian and Latin transliteration are supported.

scope.description: Default Sofia-only scope, or all cities.

city.description: City name. Providing a city takes precedence over the Sofia default.

time_from.description: Local Europe/Sofia lower boundary for the first requested date.

time_to.description: Local Europe/Sofia upper boundary for the last requested date.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event by canonical show_stable_id or legacy source ID, optionally including related performers and editorial entries.

event_id.description: Canonical show_stable_id (preferred) or legacy source ID.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search cities, venues, production titles, performers, or editorial collections. Performer and editorial results are compact; use their detail tools next.

tools.name: get_performer
tools.description: Get a SofiaStage performer or creative-team profile, biography metadata, public links, and precomputed upcoming events by exact name or route slug.

name_or_slug.description: Exact public name/title or route slug.

tools.name: get_editorial
tools.description: Get a SofiaStage editorial collection, article metadata, and precomputed upcoming events by exact title or route slug.

name_or_slug.description: Exact public name/title or route slug.
